result.summary: Reduces log spam when SOCKS5 or I2P SAM proxies are unreachable. The initial connection or listen failure logs as a warning, and subsequent failed connection attempts are logged only at debug level via LogWarnThenDebug.
result.problem: When a configured proxy is unreachable, Bitcoin Core logs every retry attempt at info level, and I2P additionally logs listen failures as errors repeatedly, flooding debug.log.
evidence: Until now every failed attempt logged the connect() failure at info level, and I2P additionally logged 'Couldn't listen' as an error (PR description)
result.changed_since_previous: Now includes full diff and functional test coverage verifying warning-once and subsequent debug-level logging behavior for SOCKS5 and I2P proxies.
result.card: Reduces log noise when SOCKS5 or I2P SAM proxies are unreachable. Currently, nodes repeatedly log proxy connection failures at info level and I2P listen failures at error level, filling debug.log during network or proxy outages. This change warns on the first failure and demotes repeat attempts to debug logging. PR #36970 depends on this PR.

risk.why: Only adjusts logging verbosity and flags for proxy connection attempts without changing network retry behavior or socket handling.
